claims.text: Equimolar WTaTiVZr consists of 20 at.% each W, Ta, Ti, V, and Zr.
The homogenized WTaTiVZr alloy has a random elemental distribution.
High-temperature aging reduces atomic lattice distortion in WTaTiVZr.
High-temperature aging reduces planar elemental segregation in WTaTiVZr.
Atomic-level lattice strain fields govern the plastic response of WTaTiVZr.
Zr-enriched planar defects are present at grain boundaries or twin interfaces in WTaTiVZr.
Large solid-solution lattice-distortion fields obstruct dislocation glide in equimolar WTaTiVZr.
Obstruction of dislocation glide raises the yield strength of WTaTiVZr relative to pure W.
Obstruction of dislocation glide reduces the uniform elongation of WTaTiVZr relative to pure W.
Zr-enriched planar defect regions deflect cracks and dissipate energy.
Crack deflection and energy dissipation at Zr-enriched planar defects increase the fracture toughness of WTaTiVZr relative to pure W.
Homogenized WTaTiVZr will have approximately 20–40% higher yield strength than pure W under the specified test conditions.
Homogenized WTaTiVZr will have approximately 30–50% lower uniform elongation than pure W under the specified test conditions.
Homogenized WTaTiVZr will have approximately 10–20% higher fracture toughness than pure W under the specified test conditions.
Aged WTaTiVZr with reduced distortion will have lower strength than homogenized WTaTiVZr and will shift toward the strength of pure W.
Aged WTaTiVZr with reduced distortion will have higher elongation than homogenized WTaTiVZr and will shift toward the elongation of pure W.
Aged WTaTiVZr with reduced planar segregation will have lower toughness than homogenized WTaTiVZr and will shift toward the toughness of pure W.
The proposed mechanism is valid from 600–1000 °C in vacuum or helium for grain sizes below approximately 10 μm and without irradiation damage.
The proposed mechanism is not applicable if significant ordering or secondary phases form.
Testing pure W, homogenized WTaTiVZr, and aged WTaTiVZr at 800 °C in vacuum with matched geometry and microstructure provides a controlled falsification experiment.

contradictions.description: The initial state is described as having a random elemental distribution, while the mediator assumes Zr-enriched planar regions are already present. These statements require clarification that randomness refers only to the bulk matrix or that segregation develops during processing; otherwise they conflict.
